title: Verify that the page Status dropdown offers and stores the Draft value

steps.action: Open the Chamber's Law page record in Liferay CMS
steps.expected: Record opens with the Status dropdown available

steps.action: Open the Status dropdown and select Draft, then click Save
steps.expected: The dropdown lists exactly Draft and Published; Draft is selected and saved with the success toast shown

title: Verify that the page Status dropdown offers and stores the Published value

steps.action: Open the Chamber's Law page record in Liferay CMS with Status currently Draft
Open the Status dropdown and select Published, then click Save
steps.expected: Published is selected and saved with the success toast shown

title: Verify that a non-integer Display Order is rejected on save

steps.action: Open a law entry record under the Chamber's Law page in Liferay CMS with Display Order currently 2
steps.expected: Law entry record opens with Display Order 2

steps.action: Enter 2.5 in Display Order and click Save
steps.expected: Save is blocked with an integer-format validation error and no success toast appears — the value is not silently rounded to 2 or 3

steps.action: Enter 'two' in Display Order and click Save
steps.expected: Save is blocked and the value is not stored. The Display Order control is a number field, so the letters never enter it and the box is left empty; the save is therefore blocked as a MISSING value, not as a malformed one, and no integer-format message is possible. Verified live 2026-09-16: the field held an empty string, the browser reported valueMissing, and the value was not stored.
